title: Sine and Cosine Circle
description: An interactive MicroSim demonstrating how sine and cosine values relate to a point moving around the unit circle, with corresponding graph visualization.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Trigonometry
learningObjectives: Identify sin(θ) and cos(θ) as the y- and x-coordinates of a point on the unit circle
Trace how a point moving around the unit circle generates the sine and cosine curves on the accompanying graph
Predict the sign of sine and cosine in each quadrant of the unit circle
Explain why sine and cosine are periodic, repeating every 360 degrees (2π radians)
Compare the sine and cosine curves to recognize that they differ by a 90-degree phase shift
